summary: Meta AI (via Alexandr Wang) announced the rollout of Muse Voice Transcribe, a real-time audio perception model for streaming speech-to-text that also performs speaker diarization and endpointing in a single model.

mechanisms.reason: The post claims a first-of-its-kind single model combining streaming transcription, diarization and endpointing, but gives no benchmark figures to substantiate the SOTA claim.
mechanisms.quote: today we're rolling out muse voice transcribe, our first real-time audio perception model - SOTA in streaming speech-to-text

practices.reason: A team building voice interfaces could investigate a single-model pipeline that combines real-time transcription, diarization and endpointing, though the claim is unreplicated and lacks numbers.
practices.quote: also handles speaker diarization and endpointing natively in a single model
